roles.title: Frontend Engineer
roles.tagline: Building interfaces that feel alive & smooth.
roles.description: You love making things you can see and touch right away. Focused on interactive UI, animation, and user experience.

roles.title: Backend Engineer
roles.tagline: The scalable engine behind the scenes.
roles.description: You enjoy thinking about data structures, APIs, and performance. Logic and efficiency are your playground.

roles.title: Mobile Developer
roles.tagline: Apps in the hands of millions.
roles.description: You want your work in everyone's pocket. Focused on responsive Android/iOS apps.

roles.title: ML / AI Engineer
roles.description: You're curious about patterns and prediction. Building models that learn from data is your passion.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: You're great at finding the story behind the data and telling it clearly.

roles.title: DevOps / Cloud Engineer
roles.description: You love making systems run automatically and reliably, from CI/CD to cloud infrastructure.

roles.title: Security Engineer
roles.tagline: The gatekeeper of the digital world.
roles.description: You think like an attacker in order to defend. Focused on system and network security.

roles.title: Game Developer
roles.description: You want to combine logic, art, and story into a fun playing experience.

roles.title: UI/UX Designer
roles.description: You care about how people feel using a product. Research, wireframes, and prototypes.

roles.title: Fullstack / Product Engineer
roles.tagline: From idea to deploy, you can do it all.
roles.description: You love building whole features — frontend, backend, all the way to release. A product-minded generalist.
